content.short: GoMining lets users own Bitcoin hashrate digitally as an NFT asset.
content.description: GoMining lets you digitally own Bitcoin hashrate as an NFT asset on the Ethereum, BNB Chain, and TON networks, without owning or maintaining any physical mining hardware. This model makes Bitcoin mining accessible to millions and unlocks the potential for Bitcoin hashrate to be used as a Real World Asset in DeFi, bridging real mining performance with decentralized finance. It provides verifiable exposure to Bitcoin mining activity while remaining compatible with DeFi ecosystems.
content.meta: GoMining is a Liquid Bitcoin Hashrate protocol. Discover GoMining and other Real World Asset Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
